career.detail.apply.title: How to Apply
career.detail.apply.desc: To apply for this position, please send us your CV and a cover letter indicating the job title in the subject line.
career.detail.apply.privacy.title: Privacy Information for Candidates (GDPR)
career.detail.apply.privacy.desc1: To allow us to legally process your application, you must include the following statement at the bottom of your CV:
career.detail.apply.privacy.desc2: "Autorizzo il trattamento dei miei dati personali ai sensi del D.lgs. 196/2003 e del GDPR (Regolamento UE 2016/679)."
career.detail.equal.title: Equal Opportunities
career.detail.equal.desc: This search is open to candidates of both sexes (L. 903/77 and L. 125/91) and to people of all ages and all nationalities, pursuant to legislative decrees 215/03 and 216/03.
career.detail.transparency.title: Transparency (Transparency Decree)
career.detail.transparency.desc: During the interview, the contract type (e.g. CCNL Confapi), working hours (full-time or part-time), and work location will be discussed in detail.
careers.hero.title: Better BIM Workflows. Built Together.
careers.hero.lead: Engineering expertise, BIM delivery and software automation — connected through focused, project-led collaboration.
careers.hero.support: We welcome introductions from BIM specialists, independent professionals and software developers interested in contributing to relevant engineering work. Opportunities depend on project needs, expertise and mutual fit.
careers.hero.track1_desc: Engineering support across defined BIM project scopes.
careers.hero.track2_desc: Relevant BIM, automation and software expertise.
careers.hero.track3_desc: Potential roles considered when actual needs arise.
careers.hero.disclaimer: Illustrative collaboration model. Engagement depends on project needs and availability.
careers.culture.title: Engineering-Led. Collaboration-Focused.
careers.culture.desc: Clear technical scope, thoughtful coordination and practical problem-solving guide how we approach engineering collaborations.
careers.culture.box1_desc: Structured BIM work, appropriate tools and documented technical decisions.
careers.culture.box2_desc: Defined responsibilities, deliverables and review expectations for each engagement.
careers.culture.box3_desc: Python, C#, Revit API and related tools considered where appropriate for the task.
careers.culture.box4_desc: Collaboration arrangements are evaluated according to project scope and availability.
careers.positions.title: Engineer the Standard. Join the R&D Lab.
careers.positions.desc: We do not hire manual modelers. We recruit algorithmic engineers and software developers to automate complex AEC workflows across the world.
careers.empty.status: Current Status: Core Unit at Full Capacity
careers.empty.desc1: We scale our operations through code, not arbitrary headcount. However, operating from the tech hub of Padua, we continuously audit spontaneous technical submissions from developers demonstrating exceptional algorithmic efficiency.
careers.empty.title: Bypass the Standard Hiring Cycle.
careers.empty.desc2: If you have transitioned from traditional BIM management to native Python, C#, or Revit API development, initiate a spontaneous technical review.
careers.empty.li1: Skip the Traditional CV: Provide a direct link to your GitHub repository or a demonstrable code environment.
careers.empty.li2: Prove the Output: Submit a custom automation script that mathematically eliminates manual data entry or visual clash detection bottlenecks.
careers.empty.li3: Initiate Contact: Route your technical portfolio directly to careers@pybim.com.
careers.empty.note: (Note: Submissions lacking functional code repositories will be automatically rejected).
careers.eng.title: Scale Your Code, Not Your Hours.
careers.eng.desc: We operate a strict R&D tech lab from the engineering hub of Padua, Italy. We evaluate our technical team based on algorithmic efficiency, not manual drafting endurance.
careers.eng.box1_desc: Zero manual modeling. Strict deployment of Python/C# pipelines and Revit API integrations.
careers.eng.box2_desc: Unrestricted access to Edge AI Appliances and dedicated GPU-VPS environments for algorithmic deployment.
careers.eng.box3_desc: Success is measured by operational bottlenecks cleared, not physical desk presence.
